description: Cs₂NaMoI₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Cs is bonded to twelve equivalent I atoms to form CsI₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CsI₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CsI₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaI₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MoI₆ octahedra. All Cs-I bond lengths are 4.26 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoI₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsI₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.19 Å. Mo is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form MoI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsI₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mo-I bond lengths are 2.83 Å. I is bonded to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Mo atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ICs₄NaMo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
